newsitem.title: USA: Isolyser CEO retires, company sets search.
newsitem.headline: Isolyser CEO retires, company sets search.

text.p: Isolyser Co Inc said chairman, president and chief executive officer Robert Taylor will retire from the company May 1.

The company named Gene McGrevin as chairman and acting president and established an executive committee to lead a search for a new chief executive officer. McGrevin most recently served as chief executive officer of Syncor International Corp.
Isolyser also named Olivia Kirtley to the board, replacing Jamal Silim who resigned due to other commitments.
Taylor, who will serve as a consultant to the company, said he will remain a major Isolyser shareholder.
